# Under/over arrow and accent references

The48 primary cases use fresh VMs of the unchanged SHA-pinned MathJax3.2.2 assets embedded in D2 v0.8.1. They cover short/long right/left over/under arrows, fraction/script bases, nested arrows, up/down stacks, ordinary arrows/vector/bar/hat/wide accents and color/bold contexts. Original complete SVG hashes, dimensions and internal operator mathaccent policy are retained.

D050's direct Overset/Underset dispatch restored the eight up/down stack cases. D081's adjacent-relation filter restores the two ordinary-arrow controls' original combined token. All 48 cases now compare unmodified primary SVGs and dimensions, and all operator markers use the original fixture values. No wrapper or geometry normalization is applied. The historical qualification fixture retains the ordinary-arrow pre-fix Go output beside the original primary output; only the primary is accepted by the tests.

All 48 marker policies are checked against the original grouping, including the ordinary-arrow pair's combined unmarked up/down token. Direct boundary controls exercise semantic parent/base exclusion, existing false/null markers, multi-character and nonmatching operators. Renderer controls distinguish explicit delimiter alias or selected size character from an ordinary stretch glyph, unselected/zero/multipart size values.

The source follows MmlMo.checkMathAccent and CommonTextNode.remappedText. Existing defined markers and embellished bases remain untouched. Only the primary's finite single-character accent set is marked, and an explicit stretch character bypasses accent remapping. The original D049 marker/remapping correction remains unchanged. The later D050 direct-dispatch change is documented separately in stack_placement_README.md. D081 changes adjacent token grouping without changing math-accent policy or introducing SVG tolerances.
